name: DxROM / Namco 108 / MIMIC-1

components.role: package-local Namco-108-family bank select/data latches and PRG/CHR address muxes

notes: Mapper 206 is replaceable external hardware. Standard DxROM has two switchable 8 KiB PRG windows followed by the final two fixed banks, two 2 KiB plus four 1 KiB CHR windows, fixed H/V or DRROM four-screen nametables, no IRQ and no MMC3 PRG/CHR mode bits. NES 2.0 submapper 1 models 3407/3417/3451 direct 32 KiB PRG wiring.
